messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Telugu, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Telugu line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
మన జీవిత మార్గం మధ్యలో నేను ఒక చీకటి అడవిలో తాను కనుగొన్నాను, అందుకే సరైన మార్గం కోల్పోయింది.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG] After the table, list any MISSING or WRONG items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Telugu translation from Step 2)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Telugu) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | **Nel** | preposition + article “in the” (locative introducing the midpoint) | **మధ్యలో** | “in the middle” | OK | | **mezzo** | noun “middle” – the exact midpoint of the journey | **మధ్య** | “middle” | OK | | **del** | preposition + article “of the” (genitive linking *cammin* to *vita*) | — | — | **MISSING** | | **cammin** | noun “road” – the path that constitutes the journey | **మార్గం** | “road” | OK | | **di** | preposition linking the possessive *nostra* to *vita* | — | — | **MISSING** | | **nostra** | possessive adjective “our” (collective speaker + addressee) | **మన** | “our” | OK | | **vita** | noun “life” – the span of human existence being spoken of | **జీవిత** | “life” | OK | | **mi** | reflexive pronoun “myself” (object of *ritrovai*) | **తాను** | “myself” | OK | | **ritrovai** | verb “found” – the act of discovering oneself | **కనుగొన్నాను** | “found” | OK | | **per** | preposition “within” – locative introducing the forest | **లో** | “within” | OK | | **una** | indefinite article “a” – marks the forest as indefinite | **ఒక** | “a” | OK | | **selva** | noun “forest/wood” – the dark forest that contains the speaker | **అడవి** | “forest” | OK | | **oscura** | adjective “dark” – qualifies the forest as lacking light | **చీకటి** | “dark” | OK | | **ché** | conjunction “for/so” – introduces the causal clause | **అందుకే** | “so / therefore” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” – specifies the particular *via* | — | — | **MISSING** | | **diritta** | adjective “right/straight” – qualifies the way as the correct one | **సరైన** | “right / correct” | OK | | **via** | noun “way” – the correct path that should be followed | **మార్గం** | “way” | OK | | **era** | copular verb “was / had been” – links *via* to its state | — | — | **MISSING** | | **smarrita** | past participle “lost / missed” – describes the state of the *via* | **కోల్పోయింది** | “was lost / missed” | OK |
---
### Missing / Problematic Items - **del** – not rendered explicitly in the Telugu line. - **di** – omitted; the genitive relationship is implied. - **la** – definite article not expressed in Telugu. - **era** – the copular verb “was/had been” is not a separate word; its meaning is folded into the verb **కోల్పోయింది**.
All other source words are represented with appropriate Telugu equivalents and their English back‑translations match the intended meanings.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING or WRONG items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Output per line: Line #, Original Translation, Issues, Corrected Translation (if any). Output final Telugu text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

**Line 1** - **Original Translation:** మన జీవిత మార్గం మధ్యలో - **Issues:** missing the genitive markers for “del” and “di” (the “of” relationship). - **Corrected Translation:** **మన జీవితము యొక్క మార్గం మధ్యలో**
**Line 2** - **Original Translation:** నేను ఒక చీకటి అడవిలో తాను కనుగొన్నాను, - **Issues:** none (all source words are represented). - **Corrected Translation:** *(no change)*
**Line 3** - **Original Translation:** అందుకే సరైన మార్గం కోల్పోయింది. - **Issues:** none (the copular meaning is conveyed by “కోల్పోయింది”). - **Corrected Translation:** *(no change)*
```text మన జీవితము యొక్క మార్గం మధ్యలో నేను ఒక చీకటి అడవిలో తాను కనుగొన్నాను, అందుకే సరైన మార్గం కోల్పోయింది. ```
